description: The current avalanche forecast for a mountain place ("Alta, UT", "Snoqualmie Pass", "Mount Hood"), a forecast zone name ("Tetons", "Salt Lake") or latitude and longitude: the danger rating (1 Low to 5 Extreme) and travel advice, danger above, near and below treeline for today and tomorrow when the center issues them, avalanche problems (type, likelihood, size, aspects and elevations), the bottom line or early-season summary, issue and expiry times, and the full forecast link. Covers every zone on avalanche.org (AK, AZ, CA, CO, ID, MT, NH, NM, NY, OR, UT, WA, WY).

center.description: Limit zone and place matching to one center id, for example NWAC, UAC, CAIC, SAC, GNFAC.

include_discussion.description: Also return the forecaster's hazard discussion (plain text, up to 3,000 characters).

latitude.description: Latitude, with longitude, instead of a place.

place.description: A mountain town, pass, peak or "lat,lon", for example "Alta, UT" or "Girdwood, AK".

zone.description: A forecast zone name instead of a place, for example "Stevens Pass", "Tetons" or "Bridger Range".

name: avalanche_forecast
title: Avalanche forecast
